svg.title: Command latency comparison
svg.desc: On these local fixtures, Umbra’s socket path had the lowest median for snapshots, clicks, field fills, eval round trips and screenshots. This is a project-authored command microbenchmark, separate from the external agent evaluation above. Each CLI command adds about 12 ms of process start-up, which is still small next to an agent's thinking time. Chromium starts faster: its figure leaves out Node's own start-up, while Umbra's includes spawning the daemon and WebKit. Chromium also loads a page full of uncached images faster unless you block images.
